items.role: Software Engineer - Digital Goods and Services Team
items.description: Built and operated services processing millions of transactions per day for top South African banks and retailers, improving transaction success rates and reducing incident MTTR via targeted observability dashboards.
highlights: Led the development and maintenance of backend services for digital goods (airtime, vouchers, money transfers, lotto), powering high-volume transactions across South Africa's top banks and national retailers.
Designed modular, plugin-based components enabling faster feature delivery and safer rollouts across multiple clients on the same platform.
Drove test automation (JUnit, Mockito), code quality (+80% on SonarQube), and CI/CD robustness (GitHub Actions, CircleCI) to support frequent, low-risk production releases.
Operated services on AWS EKS with Istio, owning deployment strategies, routing, and runtime diagnostics, and reducing incident MTTR through targeted Kibana/Elasticsearch dashboards.
Partnered with DevOps to integrate Kafka, SQS/SNS, Route53, and observability tooling into developer workflows, improving deployment reliability and debugging speed.
Prototyped internal Al-powered tools including an LLM-based code review bot and automated ticket triage system to streamline engineering and support workflows.

items.description: Browser-based gesture instrument that uses webcam hand tracking to render playable music surfaces over live video and generate synth audio directly in the browser.
highlights: github.com/sahnsookyung/chordglyph
Built multiple interaction modes including an on-camera piano keyboard with z-gated fingertip activation and a z-free circle mode for more stable performance on noisy webcam depth.

Designed calibration and tuning workflows for per-hand depth gates, per-finger sensitivity, hover/press capture, and activation thresholds to make gesture input playable rather than purely experimental.
Added real-time debug overlays, persistence of user-tuned settings in IndexedDB, and browser audio routing controls for practical testing and repeated use.
Tech Stack: TypeScript, MediaPipe Hands, Web Audio, Tone.js, IndexedDB, Vite

items.description: Local-first review workbench for turning Japanese workbook photos into Anki-ready CSV candidates through OCR, evidence-backed review, and human approval.
highlights: github.com/sahnsookyung/anki-maker-japanese
Built a human-in-the-loop pipeline that uploads workbook pages, runs local PaddleOCR with optional OCR-VL and Korean OCR paths, and extracts vocabulary and multiple-choice study candidates.
Created a review interface that shows visual OCR evidence beside editable candidates, supports rescanning field-level crops, tracks review state, and exports only trusted rows for Anki import.

Structured the system as a Next.js frontend with a FastAPI backend, OCR/extraction modules, benchmark tooling, and local-first runtime behavior that keeps generated artifacts disposable and auditable.
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, TypeScript, PaddleOCR, OCR-VL, uv, Playwright

items.description: Browser-first real-time resource-trading and route-building board-game prototype focused on deterministic multiplayer rules, server-authoritative state, replayability, and production-shaped deployment.
highlights: github.com/sahnsookyung/colonizt
Implemented multiplayer game flows with server-authoritative commands, WebSocket room state, reconnect/resync behavior, deterministic replay logs, and spectator/replay views.
Modeled core gameplay systems including setup placement, roads, settlements, cities, development cards, robber movement, discard-on-7, Longest Road, and Largest Army.

Built a broader engineering platform around the game with bots, simulations, shared protocol schemas, PostgreSQL-backed persistence, optional Redis presence, and automated property, integration, end-to-end, and smoke testing.
Tech Stack: TypeScript, React, Fastify, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, Redis, Playwright, Vitest, Docker

items.description: Full-stack intelligent system that automatically scrapes job listings from multiple platforms, extracts structured data using local LLMs (Ollama), and matches opportunities to user resumes using semantic vector search (pgvector).
highlights: github.com/sahnsookyung/JobScout
ETL pipeline with concurrent job ingestion, extraction, facet analysis, and embedding generation
Semantic matching engine using vector similarity between resume skills and job requirements
Fit/want scoring system to evaluate job alignment
Web dashboard (FastAPI + React) for browsing matches, viewing stats, and configuring alerts
Async notification system with Redis queue for Discord/email digests
Pipeline orchestration with preemption logic for concurrent execution
Tech Stack: Python, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis, Ollama, Docker, SQLAlchemy

items.description: An end-to-end local voice agent using Silero VAD, Faster-Whisper (STT), Ollama (LLM), and Kokoro TTS.
highlights: github.com/sahnsookyung/LLM-voice-chatbot
Streaming TTS playback and non-blocking audio capture; latency profiling to identify bottlenecks across STT/LLM inference and audio chunk boundaries.
Sliding-window conversation history and prompt templating to control context growth across multi-turn chats.
Quantized LLMs via Ollama (e.g., Gemma-3-27b GGUF) tuned for local memory/quality trade-offs.

items.description: An interactive single-screen portfolio website featuring a hand-drawn SVG landscape with clickable regions that trigger content overlays.

Interactive SVG landscape with dynamic overlays and responsive tooltips
Multiple purpose-built content viewers (resume, photo gallery, timeline, thoughts)
Real-time Three.js particle system simulating gravitational lensing and "waterfall" effect from Korean words
Native Web Components architecture for modular, framework-less components
DOMPurify for security when sanitizing dynamically injected content
